pages.title: Flywheel Effect
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Elytra$(br2)§lEffect: §r Press R to dash toward the crosshair; invincible during the dash and able to pass through entities. Stops at walls with durability refunded.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
